instruction: Import seed_ss_gui_12_double_slot.dxf from /home/user/Desktop with File > Import, then continue editing that imported drawing rather than starting from an empty document in SolveSpace. Launch SolveSpace from `/usr/bin/solvespace` before importing `seed_ss_gui_12_double_slot.dxf`. Do not use File > Open or launch the DXF as a native SolveSpace file. Use the existing plate and slot-center guides to create the final 180 x 60 flat plate. Add two identical horizontal slots with centers at (60,30) and (120,30). Each slot has length 36 and width 10. The slots must be exactly identical and their centerline must be horizontal. Add four diameter 6 corner reference holes at (20,15), (160,15), (20,45), and (160,45). Construction or guide geometry from the seed may be changed or removed unless it is explicitly required above. When the geometry is complete, align the view to the active workplane if needed, then use File > Export 2d View, choose the DXF file type, and save the result as /home/user/Desktop/final_ss_gui_12.dxf. Do not use File > Save As for this final DXF export.
